fact_previews: The project 'Become a Highly Paid AI Prompt Engineer' was created by Mahir Bhatt.
The project aims to create 'Prompt Prodigies,' an online course focused on crafting engaging and effective prompts for AI language models.
The goal of the project is to empower individuals and businesses to harness the full potential of AI technology.
The funding goal for the project was $1,412.
The project was unsuccessful in reaching its funding goal by April 29, 2023.

fact_previews: The project aims to democratize AI knowledge and make it accessible to everyone, regardless of their background or expertise.
The course will cover prompt engineering basics, advanced techniques, best practices, and real-world applications.
The course will include hands-on exercises, expert interviews, and community-driven projects.
Backing the Kickstarter campaign provides early access to exclusive content, updates, and opportunities to connect with fellow learners and AI enthusiasts.
There is a risk that the course will not be published if the audience size is not big enough.
